concept:
Character concept for a 2D cut-out animation game. Draw ONE original creature: a FIREFLY KNIGHT standing upright in chestnut shell armour, the THIRD stage of a three-stage Wood evolution line whose first stage is image 6: a round firefly pup with a moss hood, in the same view and pose as image 1, hovering upright just above the ground on four thin wings, legs dangling, like a small knight on guard, on a plain white background. A cute, chunky creature, but an original design that must look clearly DIFFERENT from the figure the silhouette came from; not any existing character.

Image 1 (grey silhouette) and image 2 (the same figure split into numbered regions) show the PUPPET RIG the new creature will be animated on. They tell you where each part and joint is, NOT what the creature looks like: do not trace their outline. Viewer-left and viewer-right mean as seen in the picture.

KEEP FROM THE RIG (the animation moves these parts around these joints):
- the same parts, no more, no fewer, each where its numbered region is: 1 head with face and moss hood; 2 three leaves of the hood crest; 3 firefly lantern on its antenna; 4 four thin wings; 5 armoured body; 6 two arms, one holding a leaf blade; 7 two legs;
- every joint where it is and every part pointing the same way as in image 1; eyes where the old eyes are;
- each part about the size and shape of its region; the whole figure about the same size.

CHANGE (the new look, region by region):
1 head with face and moss hood: warm cream face in front; the hair crest becomes a moss-green hood shaped like a knight's helmet hood, with olive leaf-shaped tips along its spiky edge; two big dark chestnut-brown eyes (one small catchlight dot each) exactly where the old eyes are, brows angled down, a small confident grin with a tiny fang below them; no marks, no gem.
2 three leaves of the hood crest: three big moss-green leaves with olive tips and a dark-green midrib growing from the hood like a leafy helmet crest, about the same size, place and direction as the old leaves.
3 firefly lantern on its antenna: a thin dark-brown antenna stalk with the same curve, ending in a big round firefly lantern bulb of flat amber-yellow with three darker amber segment lines; no glow, no spiral, no light rays, no white centre.
4 four thin wings: four thin firefly wings of flat mint green (a soft green, not cyan) with olive veins and a thin olive rim, slim oval dragonfly-like shapes in the same places and directions as the old wings; opaque flat colour, no transparency, no glow.
5 armoured body: a warm cream body in a breastplate of chestnut-brown beetle shell with a few small yellow dots and a thin olive rim, the cream belly showing in the middle; the neck disc is a plain cream neck.
6 two arms, one holding a leaf blade: two cream arms in chestnut-brown shell gauntlets with small moss-green paws; the viewer-left paw holds a long olive-green leaf blade (a short leaf sword) lying along the forearm in the place of the old dark leaf, its point at the lower left; the viewer-right arm hangs down-right, paw clenched.
7 two legs: two short legs: cream thighs, chestnut-brown shell greaves on the shins, small moss-green feet at the BOTTOM ends.

ATTITUDE: a proud little knight ready to strike: brows angled down, a confident grin with a small fang; cute, never scary, never a cheerful mascot.

{RENDER}
{DESIGN}
The style sheet is image 3; the hand-drawn map is image 4. Image 5 is an approved character of this game: copy its ink line weight and its pencil and crayon texture, not its design; it has a few white shine spots and some darker shading: do NOT copy those. Image 6 is the approved first stage of this creature: keep its colours, face and drawing style; this stage is the same creature grown up.

COLOURS: warm cream fur on the face, body and thighs, a moss-green hood with olive leaf-shaped tips, chestnut-brown beetle-shell armour with small yellow dots, a flat amber-yellow firefly lantern, big dark chestnut-brown eyes, four thin wings of flat mint green (a soft green, not cyan) with olive veins, an olive-green leaf blade. Few colours.

AVOID: a white face with a green-and-yellow hair streak, cyan or turquoise ears or wings, clover leaves, a glowing ball, light rays, a ring or swoosh around the body, a fairy with cyan leaf-shaped wings, a yellow-gold body, a gold forehead gem with a crescent, a spiral around the antenna ball, text, labels, numbers, the region colours, frames, background scenery, a second view, shading, shadows, white highlights, glossy shine, glow, gradients.
